title: Gelato katika Shamba la Ikeda na mabango ya Tobidashi-kun kote Shiga
label: Ziara ya siku moja Shiga

text.Last, I went to Ikeda Farm in Shiga Pref: Mwisho, nilitembelea Shamba la Ikeda katika Mkoa wa Shiga.
text.🐄 A cow version of the tobidashi sign: 🐄 Toleo la ng’ombe la bango la tobidashi
text.I do not know if it is the Kansai area o: Sijui kama ni katika eneo lote la Kansai au Shiga pekee,
text.but when you go to Shiga, you see so man: lakini ukienda Shiga, utaona mabango mengi ya mtoto anayeonekana kukimbilia barabarani.
text.When you see it many times on the road,: Unapomwona mara nyingi kando ya barabara, polepole unaanza kumpenda Tobidashi-kun huyu.
